prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn quick mouse gestures, hotkeys, and voice commands to summon or hide your pet anytime.", "Got It!"]
1: ["Design Your Perfect Desktop Companion", "Select a personality archetype and test its desktop behaviors in real time.", "Choose Archetype"]
2: ["Secure Your Pet Account & Sync State", "Set up instant pet recovery so your companion is never lost when logging in on new devices.", "Cloud Pet Save Enabled", "Your pet progress syncs automatically."]
3: ["Claim Your Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop companion a name to begin your journey."]
4: ["Tip: Right-click the desktop pet tray icon anytime to bring your pet to the front or open controls."]
5: ["Initializing Desktop Engine & Pet Shaders", "Desktop Engine Initialization Steps"]
6: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Choose Instant Preset Companion for immediate setup or Custom Photo Pet for personalized generation.", "You can add more pets later from the desktop tray menu."]
7: ["We will play a gentle chime and alert you as soon as your pet lands on your screen."]
8: ["Bonus Unlocked: Starter Toy Pack", "Your pet will spawn on your desktop with an exclusive starter item!"]
9: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Your pet lives directly on your Windows desktop, playing, walking, and keeping you company while you work."]

verdicts.problem: Mentions bonuses or free extra items
